notes: Raw schematic was treated as primary; detected overlay and crops were used only as visual aids.
Pxx and Gxx tags were treated as wire/terminal evidence, not matrix nodes.
Solid bus taps with filled dots were asserted as electrical connections; visual crossings without filled dots were not asserted.
Open switch/breaker symbols were still modeled as named device nodes connected to their visible external conductors; internal contact state was not converted into additional self-loops.

Dashed C01 and C04 are asserted because each visibly terminates between two named devices. Other dashed central/bottom routing was recorded as uncertain when it looked like cable tray or internal routing rather than a clear point-to-point connection.
